summary: Iteration 2 E2E of HostNesia redesign + service detail + notifications + invoice PDF. Backend pytest 21 passed / 1 skipped (insufficient-balance, not deterministic). Frontend: login, redesigned dashboard (4 stat cards, white Saldo card with (+) top-up, notification bell with badge=4 and panel), Active Services LIST with per-row 'Kelola' dropdown (4 items: Detail Layanan / Kelola DNS / File Manager / Login cPanel), Service Detail page with DNS/Email/SSL/Backup tabs (SSL Aktif shown, Backup 'Buat Backup' triggers success toast), Order dialog opens from stat-order, Top-up dialog works (saldo 1.500.000 -> 1.750.000 via preset 250.000), Billing page has invoice-pdf-<id> buttons labelled Struk / Invoice and GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf returns 200 application/pdf (magic %PDF verified). One critical frontend bug found & fixed: BillingPage.jsx referenced undefined `downloadPdf`, which would ReferenceError on click; added the function that fetches the PDF as blob and triggers a browser download.

ui_bugs.issue: onClick={downloadPdf} referenced an undefined function (ESLint no-undef). Clicking any 'Invoice' / 'Struk' button would throw ReferenceError and no PDF would download. Fixed in-place by adding a downloadPdf() that calls api.get('/invoices/{id}/pdf', responseType:'blob') and triggers <a download>.

rca_of_the_issue: In BillingPage.jsx the JSX called `onClick={downloadPdf}` but no such symbol was in scope (neither imported nor defined inside InvoiceRow). React would still render, but the first click on any Invoice/Struk button would throw `ReferenceError: downloadPdf is not defined`, silently failing the PDF download UX. Root cause: E1 wired the button before implementing the handler. Fix: defined `downloadPdf` inside InvoiceRow that GETs /api/invoices/{id}/pdf with responseType=blob, creates an object URL, and triggers a hidden <a download> click; errors are surfaced via sonner toast.
